name: sidenote
description: Read, search and edit your Sidenote notepads with your sync key. Notes are decrypted on your computer only.

sync_key.title: Sidenote sync key
sync_key.description: In Sidenote: Settings → Sync & devices → Show. It starts with sync-. Stored in your system keychain.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Only read and search; never change notes.
